name: Study Hall
description: +10 max HP. Quiet room, quieter nerves.

name: Extra Credit
description: +6% damage. Handed in early, marked generously.

name: Homework Club
description: +6 reach. Someone else's ruler, borrowed indefinitely.

name: Sharpened Point
description: +5% crit chance. The sharpener by the door finally works.

name: Second Wind
description: +20 max HP and +3 armour. You remembered to breathe.

name: Honour Roll
description: +12% damage and +3 Ink on hit. Your name is on the wall.

name: Quiver Check
description: +10 Ink. Count your ammunition before the bell.

name: Steady Aim
description: +5% crit chance. Breathe out, then release.

name: Long Shot
description: +14 reach. From the back of the classroom.

name: Quick Draw
description: +15% attack speed. The band is always loaded.

name: Pencil Volley
description: +10% damage and +20% crit damage. Everyone gets a turn.

name: Valedictorian
description: +15% damage and +5% crit. A speech nobody asked for.

name: Bully Pulpit
description: +15 max HP. You have the floor, and the doorway.

name: Braced
description: +4 armour. Feet apart, shoulders square.

name: Doorway Stance
description: +4 armour and +4 reach. Nothing gets past.

name: Detention Glare
description: +8% damage. The look that ends a hallway.

name: Hall Sweep
description: +10% damage and +6 reach. Clearing the corridor, one kid at a time.

name: Tenure
description: +30 max HP and +6 armour. They cannot remove you now.

name: Hall Pass
description: +8 move speed. Legally nowhere, physically everywhere.

name: Quiet Steps
description: +5% crit chance. The floor stops squeaking for you.

name: Shortcut
description: +10 move speed and +10% attack speed. Past the boiler room.

name: Marked Absent
description: +10% damage. Nobody saw anything.

name: Cut Class
description: +8% crit and +8% damage. The lesson continues without you.

name: Unseen
description: +15% damage and +25% crit damage. A rumour with a stapler.
